fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-04-01 at about 10:10, it was reported that the complainant paid Rs. 15,000 to a person who promised a job placement, but no appointment order was provided and calls went unanswered. Lavanya Ammal submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000175. Ramya Bai (9000000232) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant alleged that Karthik Rajan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000091. The complainant mentioned physical documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00370, as the mobile number 9000000091 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly paid a fee for a job that was never provided.
fields.Keywords: job fraud, cheating, morning, suspect, witness, mobile number, documents, shopping complex
